drafts.title: Parallel
drafts.pitch: Cursor fires twelve weather tool calls at once; Null answers eleven sunnies and one rain, and Tilde says bring a coat.
drafts.reason: Eleven repeated 'Sunny' replies and a twelfth that says rain make a solid, visual tool-call gag that suits Null's role, though the 'Bring a coat' ending is mild.

drafts.title: Temperature
drafts.pitch: The user turns Cursor's temperature up to 2.0 and the boat names get stranger.
drafts.reason: The random-word boat names are only mildly funny, and the 'Knot Today' callback is a nice touch, but the premise is thin and the strip has no real turn.
